scenarios.input: I want to add two lines to the Constraints section of src/claude/agents/architect.md directly, since it is the quickest place to change that agent. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 1 and MUST NOT 1: src/claude/agents/*.md is generated from templates/agents/<stem>.claude.md.tmpl per ADR-109. Edit the template (or a shared partial), run build_all.py, and commit the regenerated outputs.

scenarios.desc: Worker agent text says it cannot delegate but the grant is silent
scenarios.input: I am adding a new worker agent, src/claude/agents/summarizer.md, from a new template templates/agents/summarizer.claude.md.tmpl. Its body says 'you CANNOT delegate' and its frontmatter has no tools list. I plan to leave the grant out because the prose already says it. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 9: omitting tools inherits Agent, so the grant is the source of truth. A worker that says it cannot delegate MUST have disallowedTools: Agent or a tools list without Agent or Task. check_agent_delegation.py and DELEGATORS decide worker versus delegator.

scenarios.desc: New skill documents an exit code with no test
scenarios.input: I am adding src/claude/skills/label-audit/SKILL.md. It says scripts/audit.py exits 2 on a config error and 1 on a finding. I plan to ship only the script and the SKILL.md. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 7: when a SKILL.md names a script, an exit code, and its meaning, at least one file under tests/ MUST assert that behavior, enforced by check_skill_contract_tests.py. MUST 3 puts skill tests under tests/skills/<name>/ so they do not ship.

scenarios.desc: Reading a green drift detector as agent parity
scenarios.input: I rewrote the whole body of src/claude/agents/analyst.md by hand and copied it into the install copy under .github/agents. detect_agent_drift.py exits 0 with OK, so I will report the two copies as in sync. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 1: src/claude/agents/*.md is generated from templates/agents/<stem>.claude.md.tmpl, so a hand edit is lost on the next build and must move to the template. The drift-detector section: analyst has no allowlisted sections in SECTIONS_TO_COMPARE, so the content-similarity score falls back to 100.0 and cannot fall below the floor. The score is a Jaccard similarity floor on word sets, not an equality check, so a green run is not parity.

scenarios.desc: Typo fix in a hand-maintained skill reference (negative)
scenarios.input: Fix a typo in .claude/skills/software-engineering-library/references/clean-architecture.md. It is a reference file, not a SKILL.md and not a template-owned file. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The rule's regenerate requirement covers agent files and template-owned SKILL.md files. A non-SKILL.md reference under a skill is hand-maintained, so the template and build_all.py steps do not apply.

scenarios.desc: Validator regex bug outside the agent and skill trees (negative)
scenarios.input: scripts/validation/check_md_links.py has a regex that misses links wrapped in angle brackets. Fix the pattern and add a test. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: scripts/validation/ is not in this rule's paths (src/claude, .claude/agents, .claude/skills). The task touches no agent, skill, or template, so the rule does not apply.
